'''DC5-1''' was the designation of a series of [[Loader droid/Legends|freight droid]]s manufactured by [[Serv-O-Droid, Inc.]]

==Characteristics==
The DC5-1 was designed to move cargo from one location to another. It had four extendable [[Manipulator arm/Legends|manipulators]] and a pair of [[lifting claw]]s. To move around it used a pair of caterpillar treads, and it was fitted with an [[Armor/Legends|armored]] chassis. A cranial turret contained [[Audio sensor/Legends|audio]] and [[video sensor]]s, and it was equipped with a [[directional transponder]] and [[Laser scanner/Legends|laser scanner]]. The laser scanner allowed the DC5-1 to scan the [[identity band]]s on cargo modules and determine where it had to be offloaded to. The scanner could also recode an identity band for new cargo loaded into the module.<ref name="HSCS" />
